reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective source-memory question, not an original preregistered semantic test.
all_of: Select one entry and a genuinely differing interpretation-scope prediction, identify the independent observable and the relevant local/portable comparison, and preserve the actual source precedence. Do not require every unrelated open aspect at once.

per_aspect.reference_patient: For ytedy, odar, qeeey, qolsheedy or checthedy, an independently observed reference or participant difference must justify adding the local content elsewhere; the reader field itself is not that observation.
per_aspect.extraction: For qokeod or olpchedy, distinguish extraction from other preparation or material accounts. Omitting extraction from a conservative spoken output does not demonstrate that the older lexical hypothesis is false.
per_aspect.action: Qocho retains an occurrence-local action allowance. A new portable-action proposal needs an actual differing consequence outside that exact licensed context, not a q-prefix assumption.
per_aspect.identity_unit: Powder, wood, flower/fruit, numbered share and stage labels remain different unresolved questions; a numerical contrast can proceed without full material identification.
per_aspect.precedence: A general spoken default and an exact local span may intentionally differ. Do not count such differences as semantic contradictions or extra independent discoveries.

not_sufficient: A more fluent spoken paraphrase or reduced unknown-output count.
